name: Aida Sekkei Co. Ltd.
summary: Aida Sekkei Co., Ltd. engages in the sale and construction of pre-build and custom build homes. It also designs, constructs, and sells residential houses; builds customer made homes; and also provides real estate leasing, trading, brokerage, and other services. The company was founded by Sadamitsu Aida on January 6, 1981 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.
